verdict.rationale: Supabase Auth documents MFA for application users, with enrollment, challenge and verify flows plus guidance on enforcing it in the app. It also documents enterprise SAML 2.0 SSO for project end-users with Okta, Entra/AD, Google Workspace and Auth0, which covers the core of the story. missing for 10: evidence of enterprise OIDC SSO (only SAML 2.0 is documented), detail on how MFA is required (only 'app-level enforcement guidance' is mentioned, with no platform-level enforcement setting), independent or hands-on corroboration.
